messages.author: 3ef7a01c7d912ca2
messages.subject: Don't use linebreaks in DESCRIPTION/RcppModules
parts:
I had some troubles to resolve the following error when creating a package with Stan modules; under Windows, if it matters:

Error : .onLoad failed in loadNamespace() for 'gastempt', details:
  call: value[[3L]](cond)
  error: failed to load module 
stan_fit4linexpgastro_1b_mod from package gastempt
Failed to initialize module pointer: Error in FUN(X[[i]], ...): 
no such symbol _rcpp_module_boot_
stan_fit4linexpgastro_1b_mod in package gastempt


..until I noted that the strange line break after boot_ was no wrapping problem, but real. This was in my DESCRIPTION

....
    Rcpp (>= 0.11.0),
    RcppEigen
RcppModules:
    stan_fit4linexpgastro_1b_mod
RoxygenNote: 5.0.1

I reformatted this to

RcppModules: stan_fit4linexpgastro_1b_mod

and everything is fine. This is no question, just a memo in case someone else has the problem and searches for _rcpp_module_boot_

Dieter
